annotations.title: How much of a US stock the covered ETFs own

description: For one US stock, the share of its shares outstanding held by the covered US ETFs, as a lower bound: at least this percent, from this many funds, with the shares held, the SEC's count of shares outstanding and its date, the holdings dates and the method. The basis says whether the percent is of the whole company, every class counted, or of the ticker's class alone. Also where the figure ranks by percent among those measured, and the share of the covered US stock ETFs' money in the ten largest US companies they hold, a company without a stock file here included. A stock without a figure comes back with the reason.

ticker.description: A US stock ticker, for example NVDA or BRK.B. BRK-B and BRK/B are read as BRK.B.
